_what: The regression corpus, as DATA. Each key is a fixture file; the value says which rules must fire in it (fixtures) or which fault/repair pairs must make a rule go quiet (mutations). Seeded from the origin project. FK2 splits these into entries the KIT owns -- a rule general enough to survive the portability test brings its own neutral fixture -- and entries a FILM owns.
_why_not_code: They were literal dicts keyed by one film's filenames, inside the engine. The kit's own lint caught it: a project noun in code is a project the engine knows about, and the engine is supposed to know about none.
